description: Search the sevDesk API catalogue (151 operations, API 2.0.0) for the operationId of anything not covered by a dedicated tool. Available tags: AccountingContact, Basics, CheckAccount, CheckAccountTransaction, CommunicationWay, Contact, ContactAddress, ContactField, CreditNote, CreditNotePos, Export, Invoice, InvoicePos, Layout, Order, OrderPos, Part, Report, Tag, Voucher, VoucherPos.

kind.description: Filter by effect: read (GET), write (POST/PUT/DELETE), or all.

query.description: Free-text search over operationId, path, tags and summary, e.g. 'voucher pdf'.

tag.description: Restrict to one resource tag, e.g. 'Voucher' or 'Invoice'.

name: sevdesk_list_operations
title: List sevDesk API operations
